hero.summaryLead: A chloride-process, multi-application rutile titanium dioxide pigment with a bluish tone, high brightness and high durability.
hero.summaryBody: Architectural and automotive coating evaluation is the primary path. Plastics, masterbatch and printing-ink directions provide additional routes for product evaluation. Review the M-510 technical data below and confirm final suitability through testing in your own formulation and application conditions.

positioning.heading: Where M-510 Fits in Product Evaluation
positioning.lead: M-510 is a specially surface-treated rutile titanium dioxide pigment produced by the chloride process.
positioning.body: Its multi-application profile supports a coatings-first evaluation path, with additional directions in engineering plastics, masterbatch, profiles and printing inks. Use M-510's listed features and typical technical data to determine whether it should enter formulation testing for your application. Final grade selection should account for the complete formulation, dispersion and processing conditions, target performance and destination-document requirements.
decisionPoints: Zirconia, alumina and organic surface treatment
Coatings-first evaluation with secondary plastics, masterbatch and printing-ink directions

applications.heading: Application Directions to Evaluate
applications.intro: Review each direction in the buyer's own formulation, processing and application conditions.

items.title: Architectural Coatings
items.body: Evaluate M-510 in interior and exterior architectural coating formulations where its bluish tone, brightness and rutile pigment profile are relevant to the formulation target.

items.title: Automotive Coatings
items.body: Include M-510 in evaluation for automotive OEM and refinishing paint systems. Confirm appearance, compatibility, processing and final performance in the complete coating formulation.

items.title: Other Coating Systems
items.body: M-510 may also be evaluated in coil coatings, anticorrosion paints, decorating coatings and powder coatings. Each system requires its own formulation and application testing.

items.title: Engineering Plastics and Masterbatch
items.body: For secondary application evaluation, review M-510 in engineering plastics, masterbatch and profile systems under the buyer's actual processing conditions.

items.title: Printing Inks
items.body: M-510 may be evaluated in letterpress, offset and intaglio printing inks, with final suitability determined in the buyer's ink formulation and printing process.

evaluation.heading: What to Evaluate in Your Formulation
evaluation.intro: Use the current product data to frame buyer testing in the intended formulation and application conditions.

groups.heading: Optical and Appearance Evaluation
items: M-510 is identified by a bluish tone and high brightness.
During formulation testing, review color direction, brightness, dispersion and the finished appearance required for your coating, plastic or ink system.

groups.heading: Durability and Versatility Evaluation
items: M-510 is identified as a high-durability, multifunctional grade.
Evaluate durability, compatibility, processing behavior and final performance under the formulation, substrate, application method and service conditions relevant to your project.

evaluation.disclaimer: These evaluation directions describe what to check during buyer testing. They do not guarantee a fixed result in every formulation or application.

technical.heading: Typical Technical Data
technical.intro: Review the typical properties in the current M-510 TDS as an input to formulation evaluation.
technical.note: These values are typical properties and do not constitute a product specification. Confirm suitability in your own formulation and application conditions.
